name: nex-workbench
description: NEX Workbench — local-first work intelligence: MemNEX (Local System Intelligence) and DevNEX (Local Developer Control Center) on http://localhost:3900.

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -k -n CORE,API,WEB -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:watch" "npm run dev -w @nex/workbench-api" "npm run dev -w @nex/workbench-web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @nex/workbench-api" "npm run start -w @nex/workbench-web"
